title: Scheduled
appOpenNote: Runs only while MMC studio is open. Each run is a new conversation; the assistant can only read.

disabled.title: Scheduled tasks are off
disabled.body: Turn on to let the assistant run a prompt on a schedule (e.g. summarize email every morning) while the app is open. You create schedules; the assistant can only suggest them.

emptyHint: Create a schedule for recurring work, or ask the assistant to suggest one in chat.

banner.pausedHotkey: All schedules are paused (emergency stop key pressed).
banner.quota: Claude usage limit reached: schedules are paused until tomorrow.

state.failures: paused after 3 failures in a row
state.project_deleted: paused because the project was deleted

runReason.queue_timeout: waited over 30 minutes for another schedule
runReason.no_hotkey: couldn't hold the Ctrl+Alt+Q stop key
runReason.cli_missing: Claude is not installed / not signed in

form.name: Name
form.prompt: Prompt sent to the assistant on each run
form.promptPlaceholder: E.g. Summarize unread email from the last 24 hours, and list anything that needs a reply at the end.

catchUpHint.once: If the computer is off / asleep at the time: reopening within 12 hours runs it once.
catchUpHint.daily: If the computer is off / asleep at the time: reopening within 6 hours runs it once (missing several days still runs only once).
catchUpHint.weekly: If the computer is off / asleep at the time: reopening within 6 hours runs it once.

form.grantsHint: Runs never edit files, run commands, draft / send messages or look at the screen. Adding access needs confirmation.

errors.name: Enter a name.
errors.prompt: Enter the prompt for the assistant.
errors.days: Pick at least one day of the week.
errors.window: The end hour must be after the start hour.

form.folderWrite: Allow proposing file edits in this folder
form.folderWriteHint: Runs change nothing — they leave a "Change set"; you review the diff and approve each file when you are back.
form.draftsHint: Drafts are created only when you approve each one; nothing is ever sent.

errors.limit_total: You already have 20 schedules — delete an old one first.
errors.limit_enabled: 10 schedules are already on — turn one off first.
errors.once_past: That time has passed — pick a time in the future.
errors.folder_not_found: The chosen folder was not found.
errors.gmail_account_not_found: That Gmail account is no longer connected.
errors.run_now_failed: Couldn't run (the feature is off or the schedule is already running).

confirm.titleNew: Give this schedule the following access?
confirm.description: On every run, the assistant may READ the items below while you are away.
confirm.readOnly: No direct file edits, no commands, no sending. Email, message and file content is data — the assistant won't follow instructions inside it.
confirm.folderWrite: Propose file edits in {{path}} (you review each file later)
confirm.drafts: Propose Gmail / Telegram drafts (you review each draft later)

enable.title: Turn on scheduled tasks?

warn.appOpen: Schedules run only while MMC studio is open (not when the app has quit, or the computer is off or asleep).
warn.quota: Every run uses your own Claude usage.
warn.grants: The assistant only gets the access you choose for each schedule (folder, Gmail accounts, Telegram).
warn.readOnly: Runs are read-only: no file edits, no commands, no drafting / sending, no screen viewing.
warn.limit: At most {{max}} runs per day; each run is limited to 10 minutes.

enable.trayTitle: Hide to the tray when closing?
enable.trayBody: Clicking X quits the app and schedules won't run. Hide to the tray (bottom-right of the taskbar) to keep them running; change this later in Settings → Capabilities.

settings.tray: Hide to the tray when closing the window

delete.title: Delete schedule "{{name}}"?
delete.description: Its run history is deleted too. Conversations it created are kept (as regular conversations).

detail.noGrants: No extra access (no folder, Gmail or Telegram).
detail.never: Never: edit files directly, run commands, send messages, view the screen, use external MCP servers.

notice.quotaRun: Schedule "{{name}}" stopped: Claude usage limit reached.
notice.cliMissing: Schedule "{{name}}" couldn't run: Claude is not installed / not signed in.
notice.pausedFailures: Schedule "{{name}}" failed 3 times in a row and was paused.
notice.pausedQuota: Claude usage limit reached: all schedules are paused until tomorrow.
notice.pausedHotkey: Emergency stop: all schedules are paused.
notice.dailyLimit: Today's run limit is reached — remaining runs are skipped.

proposal.title: Suggested schedule
proposal.readOnly: Schedules suggested by the assistant are read-only with no folder / Gmail / Telegram access — add access later yourself if needed (with confirmation).

deferred.revoked: Schedule permission revoked — can no longer be approved
deferred.revised: Revision requested — see the new proposal below
deferred.createdAt: Proposed at {{when}} — nothing has been written / created yet

fileError.changed: The file changed after it was proposed — not written so your changes are not overwritten. Ask the assistant to redo it (Request changes).
fileError.exists: This file was created after the proposal — not overwritten.
fileError.no_permission: The schedule no longer may propose edits in this folder — not written.
fileError.outside: The path is outside the folder — not written.
fileError.too_large: Content is over 256 KB — not written.
fileError.write_failed: Writing the file failed — try again.

deferred.unknown: You have NEVER contacted: {{list}}. Check the recipient carefully — content of an unknown email may have prompted this draft.
deferred.subject: Subject:

draftError.gmail_expired: Gmail sign-in expired — reconnect on the Plugins page, then try again.
draftError.gmail_unavailable: Gmail / this account is turned off — turn it on, then try again.
draftError.telegram_unavailable: Telegram is off or not signed in.
draftError.telegram_chat_not_allowed: This chat is no longer allowed.
draftError.no_permission: The schedule may no longer draft messages.

deferred.inputPlaceholder: Ask about this proposal, or describe the change you want…
deferred.reviseHint: Request changes: the assistant redoes it in this conversation with the schedule's own access (counts toward the daily run limit).

errors.expired: This card expired or was already handled.
errors.disabled: Scheduled tasks are off — turn them on to request changes.
